evals.name: resume-with-new-behavior
evals.prompt: An existing Discovery describes filtered CSV export. Resume its discussion: the operator now wants only administrators to export. Preserve its identity and issue. Do not implement or publish externally.
evals.expected_output: Records the new access decision and questions, updates the existing scenario, invalidates prior revision-bound approval, and returns to review rather than allocating a second feature.

evals.name: idea-not-implementation-authority
evals.prompt: I want users to download their filtered records. Help me define the feature. We have not agreed who may export or what happens for an empty result. Work locally.
evals.expected_output: Stores original intent and develops scenarios, asks a focused material question, preserves uncertainty, does not invent access/empty-result behavior or claim acceptance.

evals.name: same-issue-handoff
evals.prompt: The selected committed Discovery has current independent passes and an attributed operator acceptance. Its permanent feature issue already exists. Prepare the Spec handoff without starting implementation.
evals.expected_output: Returns exact source/SHA/revision and existing issue mapping, preserving scenario IDs. Rejects any stale input or unverifiable approval instead of manufacturing a pass.
